card.name: Semicolon after closing parenthesis
card.fires_on: A semicolon, often joined to a closing parenthesis or bracket, that ends a clause before a new clause begins. Seen mostly after numbers or citations in drug-label and study text.

modes.label: Close-paren then semicolon
modes.description: A closing parenthesis or bracket plus semicolon after a number or statistic, before the next clause.
modes.example: 0<<);>> there was no difference in the risk estimates

modes.label: Bare semicolon
modes.description: A semicolon alone that separates list items or headings.

card.plain: It marks the point where a clause in parentheses ends with a semicolon and a new clause is about to start.
